body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-05-19 (Q4FY25 concall transcript): "Our own belief is that we should be doing better than this in terms of order inflow in our T&D business getting into the next year or getting into '26 itself" Metric: T&D order inflow. Target: > INR 14,461 cr. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: partly. Evidence: FY26 T&D order inflow 'closer to INR 13,000 crores' (90%); India T&D fell from ~7,000 to ~4,500 cr. Explanation given: L1 positions in large projects slipped into FY27 (May-26, prompted)
